findings.summary: The figcaption spends its last two sentences on the producer's own quality check ('The shared saver checks text bounds and overlaps. The producer inspected the 1400 by 720 preview: no clipped or overlapping labels, and both series and thresholds are legible.') rather than on what the picture shows. A reader cannot verify an inspection that happened elsewhere, and the space is what the sibling fragments use to describe the plotted series and marks; the repository's own rule puts the producer's rendered check in the gate log, not the caption. The independent read above confirms the claim itself: no label is clipped or overlapping, so nothing in the figure is misstated.

rubric_verdicts.contrast: Pass. All text is near-black on white; the population series is the mid neutral grey at about 3:1 against the page and the subject series is the feature blue at about 5:1, both clear of the background.
rubric_verdicts.data_ink: Pass. The only ink is two marker-and-line series, two threshold rules, the axes and their labels; no fills, no gridlines, no shading, no error bars standing in for data.
rubric_verdicts.decoration: Pass. No gradient, no background fill, no styled frame; the top and right spines are absent, so the left and bottom axes are the only furniture.
rubric_verdicts.label_collision: Pass. No label is clipped, overlapping another label, or overlapping the data: the rendered ink bounding box sits at x 72-1358 of 1399 and y 32-674 of 720, at least 32 px clear of every canvas edge, and the four legend entries are separated by gaps of at least 8 px. The lane-8 base marker sits on the certificate rule, which is the measurement (9.992e-11 against 1e-10), not a collision, and the marker is drawn over the rule.
rubric_verdicts.legibility: Pass. Sixteen lanes, two data series, two threshold rules and four legend entries read at a glance at the rendered 1399x720 size; decade tick labels 1e-13 to 1e-9, both axis titles and every legend label are legible, and the two threshold rules run the full plot width so each lane can be read against them.
rubric_verdicts.table_form: Pass. The image plots a per-lane magnitude comparison on a log scale against two thresholds, which is a plotted relationship the table beneath it cannot show at a glance (every head marker far below the requirement rule, every base marker above it); the same medians are also tabled in the fragment, so the figure does not carry information that is only a table.

verification.axis_calibration: y-axis decade ticks measured at rows 100.5, 230, 359.5, 489 and 618.5, i.e. 129.5 px per decade, giving log10(value) = -9 - (row - 100.5)/129.5
verification.data_match: all sixteen blue marker centres land within 0.6 px of the value tabulated for the accurate-curvature arm, and all sixteen grey marker centres within 1 px of the base arm, so the plotted points are the recorded per-lane medians
verification.instrument: read-only pixel analysis of the attached rendered PNG image-0.png; no SVG was opened, read, rendered or shown
verification.layering: at lane 8 the dotted certificate rule is absent wherever it crosses the marker, so the data are drawn over the threshold rather than hidden beneath it
verification.spot_checks: lane 11 base 1.58387081e-10 is the highest grey marker and lane 7 head 4.82458518e-12 the highest blue marker, both matching the table; lane 8 base 9.99236249e-11 sits just above the certificate rule as the table requires
verification.threshold_rules: the two horizontal rules sit on rows 230 and 359.5, which are exactly the 1e-10 and 1e-11 ticks, so the certificate and the floor requirement are drawn at the values the caption claims
